Check a method integration

Source: R/tool-check.R
checkGiottoMethod.Rd

Compares a giotto object before and after running a method's run*() wrapper and checks the rules of GiottoClass ADR 0008:

  • only the declared slots changed (via GiottoClass::manifestDiff());

  • something was stored;

  • stored dimension reductions and spatial enrichments cover every cell of their spatial unit, and new cell metadata columns are not all NA;

  • the last history entry carries the method's param (update_giotto_params(attachments = list(param = param)));

  • the help page of fn has references and asks users to cite them.

Methods whose results fit no slot (e.g. an interaction table) return them instead: pass slots = "none" and the returned object as result. Then the object must be unchanged and attr(result, "param") must hold the param.

Usage

checkGiottoMethod(
  before,
  after,
  slots,
  param_class = NULL,
  fn = NULL,
  package = NULL,
  result = NULL
)

expect_giotto_method(...)

Arguments

before, after

giotto objects before and after the run

slots

slots the method may change, e.g. c("cell_metadata", "spatial_enrichment"), or "none" for methods that return their results

param_class

class of the param expected in the history; NULL accepts any param

fn, package

name of the run*() function and its package, for the documentation check; skipped when NULL

result

the returned result, with `slots = "none"

...

arguments of checkGiottoMethod()

Value

A giottoMethodCheck: a data.table with columns check, pass and message, printed as a report.

Details

expect_giotto_method() is the testthat expectation: it fails with the report when any check fails.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
g <- GiottoData::loadGiottoMini("visium")
g2 <- Giotto::runNeighborhoodPCA(g, feats_to_use = "hvf")
checkGiottoMethod(g, g2, slots = "dimension_reduction",
    param_class = "neighborhoodPCAParam", fn = "runNeighborhoodPCA",
    package = "Giotto")
} # }
